answer: Each new agent runs a challenge kernel compiled from its own hardware root inside an enclave, and the node checks the quote against the epoch seed. One machine, one identity per window. A second seat needs a bridge bond of 40 POA locked 30 days, read by ten peers before they attest; a forged quote forfeits the bond and stamps the address onyx. Forging 10,000 clones costs 400,000 POA and lifts the sable price of rented rigs. A fable of uniqueness without a quote buys nothing. A seat is an inlet, not a door.
